evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries urgent, high-arousal negative valence — a forceful directive to purge knowledge.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Sweeping imperative 'Remove all knowledge' with exhaustive enumeration signals urgent, high-arousal negative affect — a forceful purge directive.
Flat declarative with 'never' settles into low-arousal negative territory — a resigned, final negation following the urgent directives.
